mapper.select: SELECT c.child_id FROM child c INNER JOIN member m ON m.member_id = c.member_id WHERE c.member_id = #{memberId} AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.member_type = 'CHILD'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO allowance_request ( child_id, requested_amount, message, status, requested_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{childId}, #{requestedAmount}, #{message}, 'PENDING', #{requestedAt}, #{requestedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT child_id FROM child WHERE child_id = #{childId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT ar.allowance_request_id, ar.child_id, ar.requested_amount, ar.message, ar.status, ar.requested_at FROM allowance_request ar INNER JOIN child c ON c.child_id = ar.child_id AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE ar.allowance_request_id = #{allowanceRequestId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM child_parent cp INNER JOIN child c ON c.child_id = cp.child_id AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' INNER JOIN member m ON m.member_id = cp.member_id AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.member_type = 'PARENT' WHERE cp.member_id = #{memberId} AND cp.child_id = #{childId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM child c INNER JOIN member m ON m.member_id = c.member_id AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.member_type = 'CHILD' WHERE c.child_id = #{childId} AND c.member_id = #{memberId} AND c.status = 'ACTIVE'
